**About Strava**
Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.
  
  
Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.
  
  
**About this role:**
We’re looking for a Campaign Operations Manager to join Strava for Business on a 12-month maternity cover contract, owning the delivery of sponsored campaigns across EMEA. You’ll be accountable for every campaign you run from signed contract to partner recap: multi-format, multi-stakeholder, and on time.
  
  
You’ll work with Account Managers as your commercial counterpart, and lead the delivery work with Copywriting, Localisation and external contractors where necessary. When something is at risk, you decide what to do about it and bring people along, rather than waiting to be told.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**

* Own delivery end to end: Take the signed contract and own the campaign through launch, live and wrap-up across every format in the deal, including challenges and additional promotion. You’re the single point of accountability for scope, timeline and quality.
* Plan and run the build: Turn the contract into a delivery plan. Set up campaigns in our internal tools, brief copy, creative and localisation, and manage contractors and internal teams to deadlines.
* Quality gate: Run pre-launch QA on copy, assets and targeting against the contract. Nothing goes live that you haven’t signed off.
* Manage performance in flight: Monitor live delivery, spot risks early, and make or recommend the call: optimise, reallocate or escalate. Take the partner-facing recommendation to AMs rather than just flagging a problem.
* Close the loop with Account Managers: Close the loop with Account Managers: Support renewal conversations with effective and convincing activation recaps.
* Manage and coach external contractors: Work with external contractors to enable efficient delivery across timezones.
* Make the machine better: Fix the process, templates and documentation as you go. You’ll be working in a function that’s still being shaped, so you have room to change how we deliver.

**What you’ll bring to the team:**

* 4–6 years running multi-channel or multi-format campaigns end to end, in sponsorship, partnerships, media, agency or platform environments.
* Track record of owning delivery across multiple concurrent campaigns, partners and stakeholders, and hitting dates.
* Strong judgement under pressure. You know when to fix it, when to escalate and when to push back.
* Confident partner-facing communicator, comfortable presenting results and managing expectations.

City St George’s, University of London is the University of business, practice and the professions and brings together the expertise and excellence of City, University of London and St George’s, University of London into one institution. The combined university is now one of the largest higher education destinations for London students, combining a breadth of disciplines across health, business, policy, law, creativity, communications, science and technology. Our students are at the heart of everything that we do, and we are committed to supporting them to pursue their career and personal ambitions.

Our research is engaged, at the frontier of practice and has a positive impact on the world around us.

**Background**

The External Communications and Media Officer supports the delivery of high-quality external communications and media activity that enhances City St George’s reputation, profile and visibility across external audiences.

The role is part of the External Relations directorate, which positions City St George’s as a leading university for business, practice and the professions, aligned to Vision & Strategy 2035. Bringing together marketing, communications, recruitment and admissions, the Directorate shapes a clear and compelling identity for the merged institution and drives growth in student recruitment, reputation and global reach.

Alongside targeted student recruitment, conversion and international expansion, External Relations amplifies the University’s research strengths, real world impact and contribution to society strengthening brand equity and deepening trust with partners, policymakers and the public.

Through integrated marketing, strategic communications and high performing recruitment and admissions activity, the Directorate enhances City St George’s external profile, builds stakeholder confidence and ensures the University is recognised as a first-choice destination for students and a valued civic institution in a competitive global landscape.

**Responsibilities**

This role has a primary focus on institutional and corporate storytelling, supporting the identification, development and promotion of content with strong external news value aligned to agreed University priorities. The postholder proactively identifies and develops profile-raising stories in key areas including student experience, education, employability, graduate outcomes and the University’s contribution to society.

Working closely with the External Communications Manager, and alongside Senior External Communications and Media Officers on defined stories and areas of activity, the postholder contributes to media relations activity, press office delivery and content development, helping ensure institutional stories are accurate, timely and effectively communicated.

The role supports the translation of University activity, research and expertise into clear, accessible content for external audiences and works collaboratively across External Relations to support effective amplification through appropriate channels.

**Person Specification**

The role requires strong written communication skills, curiosity, attention to detail and a proactive, flexible approach, using initiative and sound judgement to identify and deliver high impact stories that support agreed priorities. The ideal candidate will already be working at entry level in a relevant field, such as communications, PR or journalism and looking to progress their career to the next stage. A can-do attitude will be essential, alongside the ability to work unsupervised on stories. You will be as comfortable dealing with a first-year university student as with a senior university leader and able to build relationships with a diverse range of people, including external media (e.g. journalists, editors, producers) for stories with significant interest outside of the institution.

The role is subject to a probationary period of 12 months. Most people in the directorate work on a hybrid basis and it is expected that colleagues will spend the majority (at least 60%) of their usual working time on campus each week. Monday is typically a team day in our office in Clerkenwell.

**Interviews are scheduled to take place on:** dates TBC in mid-February

The selection process will involve a panel interview and a written exercise under timed conditions. Further details will be confirmed at the interview stage.

City St George’s offers a sector-leading salary, pension scheme and benefits including a comprehensive package of staff training and development.

City St George’s, University of London is committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion in all its activities, processes, and culture for our whole community, including staff, students and visitors.

We welcome applications regardless of age, caring responsibilities, disability, gender identity, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, pregnancy, race and ethnic origin, religion and belief, sex, sexual orientation and socio-economic background. **About Orchard**

Orchard is a SaaS security and compliance platform that helps organisations keep their Apple devices secure, up to date and audit-ready.

We continuously manage macOS updates, application patching and essential security controls, helping organisations overcome outdated software, security drift and inconsistent compliance without relying on manual intervention or a particular mobile device management platform.

Orchard isn't an MDM and doesn't aim to replace one. We complement existing tools by helping organisations achieve extremely high levels of patching and security compliance in areas where traditional MDM approaches struggle.

We're an early-stage company with a UK-based, fully remote team of around 10 people. We're now moving from product development and launch into our first phase of commercial growth.

That's where this role comes in.

**The role**

We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Marketing Lead to take ownership of marketing at Orchard.

You'll join at an unusually interesting point in our journey. We have a differentiated product and a clear problem to solve, but we don't have a pre-written marketing playbook for you to execute.

There are ideas, expertise and support across the business, but you'll be responsible for turning those ingredients into a coherent marketing strategy and then making it happen.

The long-term ambition is for organisations using Macs around the world to know who Orchard is, understand what makes the platform different and believe in its ability to solve problems that other approaches can't.

This isn't a role where you'll develop a strategy and hand execution to a marketing team. We don't expect you to hire or manage a team at this stage. You'll be both the person shaping our marketing approach and the person doing much of the work.

You'll report directly to our Chief Revenue Officer and work particularly closely with our CTO and Engineering Lead to develop a deep understanding of Orchard, our market and upcoming product developments.

**What you'll be doing**

You'll take day-to-day ownership of Orchard's marketing activities and relationships. Your remit will be broad and will evolve as we learn what works.

**You'll be responsible for:**

* Developing Orchard's marketing plan and recommending where we should focus our time and budget.
* Working with the CRO to agree overall marketing strategy, priorities and spend.
* Building awareness of Orchard and communicating clearly why the platform is different.
* Helping establish credibility and confidence in Orchard amongst the Mac Admin community and the wider IT, security and compliance audience.
* Creating compelling content for our website, LinkedIn, email and other relevant channels.
* Planning, creating and running email campaigns using HubSpot Marketing Hub.
* Developing and improving our SEO activity and organic visibility.
* Identifying relevant events and opportunities, and taking responsibility for the marketing activity around them.
* Representing and promoting Orchard at events in the UK and overseas.
* Building relationships with relevant communities, podcasts, partners and other organisations that can help us reach our audience.
* Developing our presence within communities used by Mac administrators and other relevant technology professionals.
* Supporting our channel strategy by helping build awareness and engagement with partners and MSPs who may sell Orchard.
* Owning the marketing side of product launches, new features and important product updates.
* Working closely with technical colleagues to turn product capabilities into clear, credible and engaging market-facing messages.
* Coming up with new campaigns, events, partnerships and other ideas that can increase awareness and generate demand.
* Measuring the effectiveness of our activity and using what we learn to continually improve our approach.

Some of our initial focus will include podcasts and community engagement, events, LinkedIn and email, but we don't expect that list to remain static. Part of your job will be helping us discover which channels and activities work best for Orchard.

**What success looks like**

Ultimately, we want marketing to contribute to Orchard gaining customers.

There are important steps along the way, and we'll look at a combination of measures to understand whether we're making progress. These are likely to include:

* Free-trial sign-ups.
* Qualified interest and inbound enquiries.
* Website traffic and engagement.
* Growth in awareness and engagement within our target communities.
* Performance of campaigns, content and events.
* Contribution to sales pipeline and customer acquisition.
* Ultimately, growth in the number of organisations becoming paying Orchard customers.

We're realistic about how marketing works, particularly at an early-stage company. We don't expect you to arrive with a perfect plan on day one, and we don't expect every campaign or idea to succeed.

We do expect thoughtful experimentation: develop a hypothesis, try things, measure what happens, learn from it and put more energy into what works.

**Who we're looking for**

You'll already have meaningful marketing experience and be comfortable taking responsibility for both strategy and execution.

We're particularly interested in someone who:

Has strong B2B marketing experience and understands how marketing to organisations differs from consumer marketing.

Has previous marketing experience in SaaS, technology, cybersecurity or marketing to technical audiences

Has experience delivering a range of marketing activities rather than specialising exclusively in a single channel.

Can take a broad commercial objective and turn it into a practical marketing plan.

Is equally comfortable thinking about strategy and getting into the detail to execute it.

Can create strong written content and communicate technical or complex ideas clearly.

Has experience with campaigns, content, events and digital marketing

**About The Role**
**Purpose**
In this role, you will lead our content and engagement team, making sure our content, social media and client communications fulfil 7IM's commercial ambitions, deliver client value and meet our regulatory obligations. Working across the wider 7IM Group and its brands, you will turn commercial priorities into engaging content that builds audiences, supports lead generation and helps clients understand what we do. You will line manage the Content Manager, Content Writer and Social Media Manager, and lead our Consumer Understanding / Consumer Duty programme to ensure our content and communications deliver good client outcomes. You will also support PR and events activity through content and social amplification.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Content & Engagement Strategy:
  
  

* Own the content and engagement strategy across the 7IM Group and its brands, turning the commercial priorities of the Senior Marketing Managers into a clear, prioritised plan.
* Set the framework, governance and standards that keep content accurate, usable, on-brand and commercially effective at scale.
* Define how success is measured – from engagement and audience growth to enquiries and client understanding – and report regularly on performance and insight.

**Team Leadership**

* Line manage the Content Manager, Content Writer and Social Media Manager, setting clear objectives and supporting their development.
* Cascade and drive the team vision, building a culture of ownership, quality, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Build a team where specialist expertise is valued and recognised, including clear progression for non-managerial roles.
* Manage capacity and prioritisation across multiple requests so the team focuses on the work that matters most commercially.

**Social Media & Audience Engagement**

* Oversee paid & organic social media across the Group's brands, working with the Social Media Manager to grow engaged audiences with a distinct voice for each brand.
* Ensure content, social and campaigns are joined up, and work with the Digital Growth & CRM team so engagement translates into enquiries and leads.
* Amplify PR, thought leadership and events activity through content and social, working closely with the Head of Brand, Marketing & Communications, Senior Marketing Managers, and PR agency

**Client Communications & Consumer Duty**

* Ensure client communications are clear, consistent and deliver good client outcomes across the customer journey.
* Lead our Consumer Understanding/Consumer Duty programme for content and communications, and support other regulatory changes that affect them.
* Partner with Compliance to ensure all content is clear, fair and not misleading.

**Collateral, Library & Workflow**

* Oversee the management of core 'hygiene' collateral and the 7IM literature library, including taxonomy, version control and regular audits to reduce duplication and complexity.
* Design and embed efficient content workflows that maintain strong governance while enabling speed to market.
* Own relationships with external content and social suppliers, ensuring high-quality delivery and clear accountability.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with the Senior Marketing Managers, Creative, Digital Growth & CRM, Sales, Investment and Compliance to deliver content that meets both commercial and regulatory needs.
* Offer clear guidance and constructive feedback to stakeholders, ensuring outputs are fit for purpose and aligned to best practice.

**About You**
**Skills**

* Leadership – set a clear direction and high standards, explain the ‘why’ behind priorities, and create a supportive team where people feel trusted, stretched and able to do their best work. Coach and develop specialists as well as generalists, and help the team navigate change with care and clarity.
* Influence – build credibility and trust with senior colleagues, and bring people together around shared priorities without formal authority. Work collaboratively with the Senior Marketing Managers, Design and Digital Growth & CRM teams, and feel comfortable saying ‘not yet’ when priorities need to be balanced.
* Audience-focused – understand what makes different audiences engage, and adapt content and tone across brands and channels.
* Commercially minded – connect content and engagement activity to business outcomes such as enquiries and leads.
* Insight-led – use performance data and insight to inform decisions and keep improving.
* Detail-oriented – maintain high standards of quality and accuracy across a broad range of outputs.
* Well-organised – balance a range of priorities and deliver within agreed timelines.
* Communications – an excellent writer and editor, and a clear and engaging speaker.
* Stakeholder management – build trusted relationships at all levels, offering clear guidance and constructive feedback.
* Proactive and adaptable – takes initiative, is curious and open to change, and enjoys taking on new responsibilities.

**Knowledge**

* Experience leading content and/or social media activity, including managing and developing people.
* Good working knowledge of social media platforms (particularly LinkedIn and Meta), along with scheduling and analytics tools.
* Understanding of Consumer Duty and financial promotions requirements is desirable.
* Knowledge of wealth management or financial services is desirable but not essential.
* Experience managing external suppliers and agencies.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office; familiarity with SharePoint and the Adobe Suite (InDesign and Acrobat) would be helpful.

**Qualifications**

* No specific qualifications are required, but degrees or qualifications in marketing or communications are desirable.

**Other Relevant Information**

* Reports to the Head of Brand, Marketing & Communications.
* Line manages the Content Manager, Content Writer and Social Media Manager.
* Works closely with the Senior Marketing Managers, Design Lead, Digital Growth

jobs.description:
At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work.
  
  
We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco.
  
  
Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.
  
  
**Why Verda**

* Cash and equity compensation along with local benefits.
* 40+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.
* A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.

**About The Role**
We're looking for a senior field marketer to own the EMEA go-to-market motion end to end — from strategy through execution. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role: you'll define the regional plan, run the programs, and be accountable for pipeline contribution across a diverse and technically sophisticated set of markets.
  
  
You'll work closely with EMEA sales leadership, co-owning account priorities, shaping joint go-to-market plans, and making marketing investment decisions that move revenue. The role spans the full mix: executive engagement programs, field events, ABM, demand generation, and partner marketing, coordinated into a regional calendar with a clear line to pipeline.
  
  
This is a builder role at a company growing fast in a space that's moving faster. You'll be the first or one of the first dedicated field marketers in the region, which means real scope to shape how marketing operates across EMEA and real accountability for the results.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define and own the EMEA field marketing strategy: the regional approach to pipeline generation, in-market presence, and customer engagement, aligned to revenue priorities.
* Build and run an integrated regional marketing calendar spanning field events, executive programs, ABM, and demand generation.
* Plan and execute regional events end to end — executive roundtables, roadshows, conferences, webinars — including theme, logistics, vendor management, sales staffing, follow-up, and reporting.
* Run 1:1, 1:few ABM programs against the region's priority accounts, partnering with Sales on account selection and activating personalized, multi-channel programs to engage buying groups.
* Serve as the primary marketing stakeholder for EMEA sales leadership — co-developing go-to-market plans, aligning marketing investment to revenue priorities, and maintaining direct alignment on account priorities, campaign promotion, and pre/post-event communication.
* Support deal acceleration with targeted programs, and fold Sales feedback back into execution.
* Execute integrated demand generation across digital, events, email, and third-party channels across the full buyer journey; localize global campaigns for EMEA markets.
* Partner with Growth and Business Development on lead-generating and pipeline-creation programs.
* Work with the partner marketing function
* Coordinate across content, partner, and product marketing to deliver cohesive programs against the accounts that matter most.
* Establish measurement frameworks and reporting cadences connecting marketing activity to pipeline, revenue influence, and account expansion; track pipeline, conversion, ROI, and cost-per-pipeline, and optimize programs and spend with a test-and-learn approach.

**Your key competencies**

* 8+ years in field marketing, regional marketing, or demand generation in enterprise B2B technology.
* Proven ability to define and own a regional marketing strategy, not just execute against one.
* Track record of building peer-level relationships with sales leadership and influencing joint planning without direct authority.
* Hands-on experience running executive engagement programs and field events that deliver measurable pipeline, including larger-scale events
* Strong command of ABM, from account selection through multi-channel activation and measurement.
* Demonstrated negotiation skills with vendors and suppliers.
* Proficiency with CRM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms as supporting tools; comfort using AI workflows to drive scale and efficiency.
* You personally ship the work — programs, briefs, follow-up, reporting — rather than orchestrating others who do.

**Strong Differentiators**

* Experience shaping field marketing across multiple EMEA sub-regions simultaneously.
* Background in cloud, data, AI, or infrastructure platform marketing.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML infrastructure — training vs. inference, GPU economics — enough to hold your own in a technical conversation and market credibly to a technical buyer.
* Familiarity with ABM tooling and account engagement platforms.
* Experience building a regional field function from scratch at an early-stage, fast-moving company.

We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.

We are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. We offer our industry stakeholders in over **150 countries** access to a global platform of high-quality vision care products (such as the Essilor brand, with Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest and Transitions), iconic brands that consumers love (such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear and Costa), as well as a network that offers consumers high-quality vision care and best-in-class shopping experiences (such as Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò and the GrandVision network), and leading e-commerce platforms.

  

Join our global community of over **190,000** **dedicated** **employees** around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry.

  

Discover more by following us on LinkedIn!

**Your #FutureInSight with EssilorLuxottica**

Are you willing to pioneer new frontiers, foster inclusivity and collaboration, embrace agility, ignite passion, and make a positive impact on the world? Join us in redefining the boundaries of what’s possible.

**Your role:**

As Trade Marketing Executive, you will play a key role in supporting the Trade Marketing Manager – Independent Channel UKI to deliver the Independent Channel strategy. You will bring marketing plans to life through engaging campaigns, impactful activations and initiatives across one of the world's most exciting eyewear and eyecare portfolios.

Working with globally recognised brands including Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Prada and Giorgio Armani, alongside market-leading lens technologies such as Varilux, Transitions, Crizal and Stellest, you will help create meaningful customer experiences and drive commercial growth.

  

**Main responsibilities:**

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the Trade Marketing Manager – Independent Channel UKI in the execution of the Independent Channel strategy for Lenses, Instruments and Wearables.

Key areas of responsibility will include, but are not limited to:

* **ELevate Partnership Programme:** Play a key role in driving the performance and growth of our flagship customer partnership programme, backed by a £1.2m investment and engaging with over 1,600 independent opticians. Deliver impactful activity that strengthens customer relationships, drives engagement and maximises the value of this significant investment.

* **Marketing Communications:** Coordinate the production and delivery of internal and external communications, including Trade press, ensuring activity is delivered accurately, on time and in line with brand and channel guidelines.
* **Point of Sale & In-Store Activation:** Manage the print buying, production and distribution of point of sale materials for customer promotions and campaigns. Ensure forecasting and allocation is done in time to maximise in-store visibility and campaign execution.
* **Customer Promotions & Campaigns:** Coordinate the end-to-end execution of customer promotions, including setting up and managing marketing campaigns across CRM and relevant digital platforms.
* **Customer Marketing Support:** Coordinate with independent customers to source, manage and deliver imagery for digital and in-store use, ensuring materials meet brand guidelines and customer requirements.
* **Trade Events:** Support the planning and delivery of exciting customer events, industry exhibitions and brand experiences. Work closely with internal teams, agencies and external partners to bring events to life, showcase our brands and create memorable experiences for our customers.
* **Independent Optical Channel and Sales Team:** Act as a key point of contact for day-to-day marketing queries from customers and internal stakeholders, providing timely support and coordinating resolutions where required.
* **Research & Insight:** Undertake market, customer and competitor research to support the development of trade marketing activity and identify opportunities to improve customer engagement and commercial performance.
* **B2C Marketing Activation:** Develop and coordinate playbooks and campaign toolkits for independent customers to use within their local community.
* **Digital In-Store Tools:** Manage the day-to-day operation and allocation of digital in-store tools, working with customers and internal stakeholders to maximise adoption and effective use.
* **Agency & Supplier Management:** Coordinate with external agencies, suppliers and production partners to deliver marketing materials and activity on time, within agreed budgets and to the required standard.
* **Marketing Tracking & Reporting:** Maintain accurate marketing records, campaign trackers and supporting documentation, and provide regular updates on activity, timelines and key deliverables.
* **General Marketing Support:** Provide day-to-day support to the Trade Marketing Manager and wider marketing team, taking ownership of agreed projects and activities through to completion.
